FOLDER FILE MP3 & COVER ALBUM TURNTABLE
=======================================
Silakan masukkan file .mp3 dan gambar cover album kamu ke dalam folder ini:
Path: public/assets/audio/

1. File Audio MP3:
   - track-1.mp3
   - track-2.mp3
   - track-3.mp3
   - track-4.mp3
   - track-5.mp3

2. File Cover Album Piringan Hitam (Tampil berputar di tengah piringan vinyl):
   - cover-track-1.png (atau .jpg, .webp)
   - cover-track-2.png
   - cover-track-3.png
   - cover-track-4.png
   - cover-track-5.png
